title: When You Can't Just Walk Away: Setting Boundaries with Co-Parents
coreMove: Structured co-parenting contact protects the child by narrowing channels, topics, timing, and hand-offs before conflict can take over every exchange.

exampleSpecs.domain: co-parent texting during a postal shift
exampleSpecs.audience: Benjamin, a parent who keeps getting old fights inside logistics texts
exampleSpecs.stakes: A school schedule reply can become another emotional exchange if the channel stays wide open.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A peer reframes the channel as a lane for the child's needs, not open access to Benjamin.

exampleSpecs.domain: parenting class using lab safety as the teaching frame
exampleSpecs.audience: Derek, a parent confused by why loose hand-offs keep exploding
exampleSpecs.stakes: Pickup and drop-off will keep turning into curbside conflict unless the plan becomes visible.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The learner's confusion about fixed sample slots becomes the way he understands fixed child hand-offs.

exampleSpecs.audience: Nadine, a parent who wants the exchange to stop pulling the child into adult tension
exampleSpecs.stakes: A vague hand-off keeps making the child watch two adults measure respect at the counter.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the same hand-off earlier and later with the fixed plan as the changed variable.

exampleSpecs.domain: reviewing co-parent message records between diner prep tasks
exampleSpecs.audience: Melodie, a parent trying to see why the shared channel keeps failing
exampleSpecs.stakes: School and health details are getting lost because every topic enters the same thread.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A review of existing messages turns on one specific find in the thread.

exampleSpecs.domain: parking garage pause before a parenting-plan reminder
exampleSpecs.audience: Soraya, a parent tempted to send a message through the child
exampleSpecs.stakes: Convenience would move schedule pressure from adult communication into the child's day.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Inside Soraya's thoughts, the easy child-messenger move gives way to the adult route.

exampleSpecs.domain: weekly co-parenting attention plan during a haircut
exampleSpecs.audience: Christophe, a parent with a crowded week and only a few calm minutes
exampleSpecs.stakes: Scarce attention can drift toward debate unless the adult route is planned first.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before acting, allocate limited attention among calendar, parenting plan, and child-messenger risks.
